newsitem.title: UK: BFI steams 25 points higher to 1,358.
newsitem.headline: BFI steams 25 points higher to 1,358.

text.p: The spot Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose sharply in brisk conditions by 25 points to 1,358 on Tuesday, brokers said.

Significant stronger fixtures for panamaxes were behind the move. Chinese charterers fixed the Konstantinou (71,550 dwt) for delivery at Passero retro for November 4 with trip via U.S. and redelivery China at $14,400 daily.
Market talk swirled that all types of panamaxes up to 25 years old were achieving much improved levels.
Caper rates also continued to rise in all areas.
Daiichi fixed the Sanko Oasis (161,000 dwt) for delivery Continent early-December with trip via Narvik and redelivery China at between $16,500 and $17,000 daily.

With the exception of handy sizes in most areas brokers were confident that freight rates would rise over the short term and that charterers of capers and panamaxes for November loading would further strengthen an already uptrending market.
BIFFEX futures gained between 25 and 50 points in a volume of over 200 lots.
